title: Electrolysis of molten sodium chloride
caption: An external supply forces a non-spontaneous reaction. Na⁺ ions move to the negative electrode (cathode) and gain electrons; Cl⁻ ions move to the positive electrode (anode) and lose them. Molten NaCl gives sodium metal and chlorine gas.
alt: A vessel of molten sodium chloride with two electrodes connected to a d.c. supply; sodium forms at the negative electrode and chlorine at the positive.
